word-kettle.def: a container with a spout and a handle, used to boil water

word-lid.def: a cover that fits on top of a pot or pan

word-cutting-board.def: a flat piece of wood or plastic that protects the table when you slice vegetables or meat

word-grater.def: a metal tool with sharp holes that turns cheese or vegetables into small pieces

word-ladle.def: a large deep spoon with a long handle, used to serve soup

word-microwave.def: a kitchen appliance that heats food quickly using electric waves

word-stove.def: a kitchen appliance with burners on which you heat pots and pans

word-blender.def: an electric machine that mixes food and drinks into a smooth liquid

word-dishwasher.def: a machine that cleans plates, glasses and silverware with water and soap

word-toaster.def: a small electric machine that browns slices of bread

word-coffee-maker.def: a machine that brews a hot, dark drink from ground beans

word-freezer.def: an appliance or compartment kept below 0°C to store food for months

word-teaspoon.def: a small spoon for stirring drinks, or the amount it holds

word-tablespoon.def: a large spoon for serving food, or the amount it holds

word-chop.def: to cut food into small pieces with a knife

word-slice-v.def: to cut food into thin, flat pieces

word-peel.def: to take the skin off a fruit or vegetable

word-grate.def: to shred food into small pieces by rubbing it on a tool with sharp holes

word-whisk.def: to mix eggs or cream quickly with a light tool to add air

word-roast.def: to cook meat or vegetables in an oven with dry heat

word-grill-v.def: to cook food on metal bars over strong heat

word-steam-v.def: to cook food using the hot vapor from boiling water

word-defrost.def: to let frozen food become soft and ready to cook

word-marinate.def: to leave food in a flavored liquid before cooking it

word-season-v.def: to add salt, pepper or herbs to food to improve its taste

word-set-the-table.def: to arrange plates, glasses and cutlery where people will sit to eat

word-wash-dishes.def: to clean plates, cups and cutlery after a meal

word-knead.def: to press and fold dough with your hands

word-let-cool.def: to wait until hot food is no longer hot

word-crispy.def: hard and dry in a way that makes a sharp sound when you bite it

word-juicy.def: containing a lot of liquid when you bite or squeeze it

word-ingredient.def: one of the foods you mix together to make a dish

word-pinch.def: a very small amount of something, held between your finger and thumb

word-dough.def: a thick, soft mixture of flour and water that is baked into bread

word-yeast.def: a tiny living substance that makes bread dough rise

word-baking-powder.def: a white powder that helps cakes and cookies rise

word-cinnamon.def: a sweet brown spice made from tree bark

word-broth.def: a thin soup made by boiling meat or vegetables in water
